notes.title: Strange Lands Version 0.11
notes.content:
This update has been a long time in the making. With a focus on polishing world 4, it also brings a number of improvements and bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Major work on levels in world 4 to bring the fun
[*] Reworked spring tilesets
[*] Reworked castle tilesets
[*] Added menu screen displaying controls and how to play.
[*] When the player gains the speed powerup, the world slows down (bullet time)
[*] Bats eyes now glow in the dark
[*] Specters in cursed world now burn with green fire
[*] Better support for different resolutions
[*] Small crystal size increased
[/list]

tags.feature: - Added menu screen displaying controls and how to play.
- When the player gains the speed powerup, the world slows down (bullet time)
- Bats eyes now glow in the dark
- Specters in cursed world now burn with green fire
- Better support for different resolutions

notes.title: Strange Lands Update 0.10
notes.content:
Another small update with some big changes. This update focused mainly on bringing more fun to world 3, but also includes a few quality updates that affect the whole game.
[list]
[*] Improved rendering menus at different resolutions.
[*] Updated mouse cursor art
[*] Updated game title art
[*] Updated tile art (Castle Ice bricks, dirt, Winter rocks)
[*] Fixed a bug where tile sprites would be rendered slightly off
[*] Added particle effects when collecting crystals and other items
[*] Fixed memory leak
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where tile sprites would be rendered slightly off

tags.feature: [*] Added particle effects when collecting crystals and other items

notes.title: Strange Lands Update 0.9
notes.content:
A small update that brings some bug fixes, improved level content, and updated art!
[list]
[*] Improved backgrounds, making them more in line with the feel of the game
[*] Improved art for ice levels.
[*] Fixed bug in sprite rendering that would result in all sprites/tiles being slightly squished.
[*] Fixed bug where player could throw objects through unpassable tiles.
[*] Fixed Bug where player collision detection would not pick the closest blocking object to halt movement
[*] Completed review of Levels 2-1 through 2-4
[/list]

notes.title: v0.2 Autumn Update
notes.content:
A big thanks once again to everyone supporting Strange Lands. It's been such a fun time building the game I want to play.

In this update:

[list]
[*] Additional 4 levels of autumn-themed content
[*] Tweaks to existing content, including making the world 1-4 boss fight make a little more sense, and a warp zone hidden somewhere in 1-2. ;)
[*] Improved controller support

I'd noticed that Steam would sometimes override my controller button mapping in a way that broke it completely(Thanks, Steam!).
 I've added a change that should work around this annoyance. I'd love to hear feedback from the community about whether or not  you're using a controller rather than keyboard input, and whether it works well for you or not.

For anyone having problems using their controller with Strange Lands, please try the following workaround.
- If the "Steam Input Per-Game Setting" option is enabled for Strange Lands, then disable it. If it's enabled, then disable it.
The setting can be found by right-clicking Strange Lands in your library, and selecting "Properties..."
[/list]
			Lots more to come in future updates!
